Music_MasterAudioEnhancement.title: Master Audio Enhancement
Music_MasterAudioEnhancement.description: Configurable DSP mastering chain with optional speech enhancement, EQ, dynamics, stereo shaping, loudness management, and peak limiting.

Music_Fix.title: Music Fix
Music_Fix.description: Conservative genre-informed finishing presets with subtle EQ, linked compression, stereo shaping, loudness management, and peak protection.

Music_AudioRepair.title: Audio Repair
Music_AudioRepair.description: Repairs short clipping plateaus, isolated clicks, invalid samples, and DC offset before mastering.

Music_NoiseRemove.title: Noise Removal
Music_NoiseRemove.description: High-frequency hiss reduction or full stationary noise reduction.

Music_AudioUpscale.title: Audio Resample
Music_AudioUpscale.description: Band-limited sample-rate conversion from 16 kHz to 192 kHz. Resampling does not recreate missing source detail.

Music_StereoEnhance.title: Stereo Enhance
Music_StereoEnhance.description: Mid/side stereo widening with mono-to-stereo channel handling.

Music_LufsNormalizer.title: LUFS Normalizer
Music_LufsNormalizer.description: Integrated loudness measurement and normalization using ITU-R BS.1770 when pyloudnorm is available.

Music_Equalize.title: 3-Band EQ
Music_Equalize.description: Three-band peaking equalizer with validated Nyquist-safe frequencies.

Music_Compressor.title: Compressor
Music_Compressor.description: Stereo-linked dynamic range compression with threshold and ratio controls.

Music_Gain.title: Gain
Music_Gain.description: Exact linear gain adjustment from -24 dB to +24 dB.

Music_AudioMixer.title: Audio Mixer
Music_AudioMixer.description: Mixes two tracks with sample-rate conversion, mono/stereo matching, and duration padding.

Music_AudioTrimmer.title: Audio Trimmer
Music_AudioTrimmer.description: Extracts a validated time range while preserving batch and channel layout.

Music_StemSeparation.title: Heuristic Stem Split
Music_StemSeparation.description: Fast DSP-based harmonic, percussive, bass, music, and residual split. This is not neural source separation.

Music_StemRecombination.title: Stem Recombination
Music_StemRecombination.description: Recombines five stems with individual levels, rate/channel matching, and safe headroom.
